description: This file contains a collection of common shell functions used for environment setup, process management, verbosity control, and Android device interaction via ADB, including functions for error handling, logging, and device communication.

methods.name: adb_check
methods.description: Checks for the presence of the Android 'adb' tool, verifies its version, and sets internal state accordingly.

methods.name: adb_get_program
methods.description: Returns the path to the detected adb program, or empty if not found.

methods.name: adb_get_error
methods.description: Returns the last error message related to adb operations.

methods.name: adb_check_device
methods.description: Verifies that exactly one Android device is connected via adb and sets the serial number.

methods.name: adb_shell
methods.description: Executes a shell command on the connected Android device via adb, returning output and status.

methods.name: adb_push
methods.description: Pushes a file from host to Android device.

methods.name: adb_pull
methods.description: Pulls a file from Android device to host.

methods.name: adb_install
methods.description: Pushes a file to the device and panics if the operation fails.

methods.name: increase_verbosity
methods.description: Increases the verbosity level for logging and command output.

methods.name: decrease_verbosity
methods.description: Decreases the verbosity level.

methods.name: verbosity_is_higher_than
methods.description: Checks if current verbosity is higher than a specified level.

methods.name: verbosity_is_lower_than
methods.description: Checks if current verbosity is lower than or equal to a specified level.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs a message if verbosity level is >= 0.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Outputs a message if verbosity level is >= 1.

methods.name: set_run_log
methods.description: Sets a file to log command outputs.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs a command, outputting to stdout or logging based on verbosity.

methods.name: run2
methods.description: Runs a command, with output control based on verbosity level.

methods.name: get_core_count
methods.description: Detects and returns the number of CPU cores.

methods.name: atexit
methods.description: Registers a function to be called upon script exit.

methods.name: panic
methods.description: Outputs an error message and exits the script.

methods.name: fail_panic
methods.description: Checks the last command's success; if failed, calls panic.
